queries.original: SELECT ownership.* FROM effect_agent_submission_ownership AS ownership JOIN effect_agent_submissions AS submission ON submission.submission_id = ownership.submission_id WHERE submission.thread_id = ? ORDER BY ownership.lease_expires_at DESC LIMIT 1
queries.ownershipFirst: SELECT ownership.* FROM effect_agent_submission_ownership AS ownership CROSS JOIN effect_agent_submissions AS submission WHERE submission.submission_id = ownership.submission_id AND submission.thread_id = ? ORDER BY ownership.lease_expires_at DESC LIMIT 1
queries.emptyOwnershipGuard: SELECT ownership.* FROM effect_agent_submission_ownership AS ownership JOIN effect_agent_submissions AS submission ON submission.submission_id = ownership.submission_id WHERE submission.thread_id = ? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM effect_agent_submission_ownership) ORDER BY ownership.lease_expires_at DESC LIMIT 1

effect_agent_submissions.schema: CREATE TABLE effect_agent_submissions ( submission_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, thread_id TEXT NOT NULL, queue_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, principal TEXT NOT NULL, idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, agent_id TEXT NOT NULL, agent_digests_json TEXT NOT NULL, deployment_id TEXT NOT NULL, input_json TEXT NOT NULL, input_digest TEXT NOT NULL, receipt_id TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, settled_outcome TEXT, settled_record_id TEXT, finalized_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, ready_at TEXT, input_applied_record_id TEXT, input_applied_sequence INTEGER, joined_host_submission_id TEXT, suspended_reason_json TEXT, suspended_at TEXT, unknown_reason TEXT, unknown_tool_call_ids_json TEXT, parent_submission_id TEXT, parent_tool_call_id TEXT, admission_group TEXT, admission_fence_json TEXT, worker_admission_json TEXT, message_admission_json TEXT, UNIQUE (thread_id, principal, idempotency_key), UNIQUE (thread_id, queue_sequence) )

effect_agent_submission_ownership.schema: CREATE TABLE effect_agent_submission_ownership ( submission_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL, ownership_token TEXT NOT NULL, producer_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, owner_producer_id TEXT NOT NULL, lease_expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (submission_id) REFERENCES effect_agent_submissions(submission_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT )

effect_agent_submissions.name: effect_agent_submissions_active_parent
effect_agent_submissions.sql: CREATE INDEX effect_agent_submissions_active_parent ON effect_agent_submissions(thread_id, submission_id) WHERE state <> 'settled' AND parent_submission_id IS NOT NULL

effect_agent_submissions.name: effect_agent_submissions_active_worker
effect_agent_submissions.sql: CREATE INDEX effect_agent_submissions_active_worker ON effect_agent_submissions(thread_id, submission_id) WHERE state <> 'settled' AND worker_admission_json IS NOT NULL

effect_agent_submissions.name: effect_agent_submissions_nonterminal
effect_agent_submissions.sql: CREATE INDEX effect_agent_submissions_nonterminal ON effect_agent_submissions (thread_id, queue_sequence) WHERE state <> 'settled'

effect_agent_submissions.name: effect_agent_submissions_group
effect_agent_submissions.sql: CREATE INDEX effect_agent_submissions_group ON effect_agent_submissions (thread_id, admission_group, state)
